name: CI

jobs:

    name: Minimum supported rust version
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      with:
        toolchain: stable minus 2 releases # MSRV policy = last three versions of stable
        components: clippy, rustfmt

    - name: Run cargo fmt --check
      run: cargo fmt -- --check

    - name: Run cargo clippy
      run: |
        # Must run before `cargo check` until we use Rust 1.52
        # See https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-clippy/issues/4612
        cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- \
          --allow clippy::unknown_clippy_lints \
          --allow clippy::unnecessary_cast \
          --allow clippy::block_in_if_condition_stmt
        # Prevent regressions of https://github.com/trishume/syntect/issues/98
        cargo clippy --all-features --lib -- --deny clippy::panic
    - name: Run cargo check
      run: |
        cargo check --all-features --all-targets
        # Check that if some other crate in the downstream dependency tree
        # enables serde's "derive" feature, syntect still builds.
        cargo check --all-features --features serde/derive

  documentation:
    name: Documentation checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        path: 'syntect'

        repository: 'sharkdp/bat'
        path: 'bat'
        ref: master
        submodules: true
    - name: bat/tests/syntax-tests/regression_test.sh
      run: |
        cd bat
        sed -i 's%\[dependencies.syntect\]%[dependencies.syntect]\npath = "../syntect"%' Cargo.toml
        cargo build --release # Build bat so we can update the assets
        PATH=$PWD/target/release:$PATH ./assets/create.sh # Update assets with newly built bat
        cargo build --release # Build bat using the newly updated assets
        # Regenerate the expected highlighted output so the regression test
        # compares two runs of the *same* syntect, not our build against an
        # old baseline committed in the bat repo.
        PATH=$PWD/target/release:$PATH tests/syntax-tests/update.sh
        PATH=$PWD/target/release:$PATH tests/syntax-tests/regression_test.sh

    name: Build and test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        submodules: true
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
    - name: Build
      run: |
        cargo build
    - name: Run tests

        cargo test --features metadata

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
